title: A Midsummer-Night’s Dream
author: William Shakespeare
summary: In a moonlit forest outside Athens, quarreling lovers, a group of amateur actors and the fairy king and queen become entangled. A magic flower's juice causes love to land on the wrong people.
readIf: you want Shakespeare's most playful comedy, full of magic and mix-ups.
skipIf: you dislike reading play scripts or archaic language.
